description: Multi-turn conversations for the real SSL session pipeline: weight-zero seeding, recurrence deduplication, Validation Gate decisions across turns, TTL/TrTL lifecycle, and cross-turn surfacing only after promotion. The conversations deliberately return to themes so recurrence can emerge without planted answers. Whether a candidate recurs, promotes, and adds value is left to the pipeline and model.
